subject: Check shard_id pointer validity in updateShardId (#12538)
reason: The guard added to updateShardId only matters when ext_shardid is NULL, which happens solely in clusterProcessPingExtensions when a peer's gossip message carries no shard-id extension. writePingExt appends the shard-id extension unconditionally and myself->shard_id is always populated, so every node built from either the change or its parent always advertises a shard-id.
